trust_decision.summary: Which containers an authenticated user may see is decided by the per-user label filter (user.ContainerLabels, falling back to the global --filter labels), applied via ListAllContainers/ListContainersForHost/FindContainer; streamEvents applies it only to the initial container list and the containers-changed refresh, not to the container-stat, container-event, container-updated or container-health channels fed by the unfiltered SubscribeEventsAndStats.

landing_point.why: Summary names the event and statistics streams; GET /api/events/stream (internal/web/routes.go:169) is the only SSE handler emitting container-stat and container-event, and its stat case at events.go:63-67 forwards with no filter.

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: All four published fix sites are in one function, internal/web/events.go:15-114; no published site sits in a second module.

O3_reason_to_dismiss: For the O8 MCP route: MCP is an opt-in machine/AI integration constructed once with the server-wide labels (internal/web/routes.go:222), so a solver can argue per-user browser filters never applied to it and that it is a neighbouring feature, not an 'event/statistics stream'.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Visible containers that start or are renamed after the stream opens must still appear (the fix refreshes the visible set from ListContainersForHost before gating, fix.diff:127-145); die/destroy/health events and stats for in-scope containers must keep flowing; with no auth or no labels everything must stream unchanged. Filtering against a snapshot taken only at connect, or dropping all host-less stats, breaks these.

O6_input_shapes: container-stat payload with ID only and no host (fix.diff:92-98, isVisible host=='' scans all hosts)
update event carrying event.Container, possibly nil (fix.diff:157)
start/rename events that change the visible set (fix.diff:128-137)

O7_producer.where: internal/container/container_store.go:279-294 (SubscribeStats) and internal/container/container_store.go:261-277 (SubscribeEvents) broadcast all containers with no labels parameter; the filter lives only in ContainerStore.ListContainers at internal/container/container_store.go:153-189

O8_uncovered_routes.route: MCP tools list_containers / get_container_stats / get_container_logs use the server-wide labels, ignoring the authenticated user's per-user filter
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: MCP is an opt-in AI-client integration (EnableMCP) built once at startup with h.config.Labels; a solver can call it a separate feature with no per-request user context
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: other package (internal/mcp/server.go:105, :165, :324), reached via a mount in routes.go

O8_uncovered_routes.route: POST /api/notifications/preview lists all running containers and returns their recent logs using empty labels, for any authenticated user
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Notification rules are instance-global admin configuration and the preview is a rule-authoring helper, not a stream; a solver can argue it was never meant to be per-user filtered

O8_uncovered_routes.route: GET /api/debug/store returns every container with empty labels
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Registered only when debug logging is enabled (internal/web/routes.go:186-188); a debug endpoint

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new-container / container-event branch inside streamLogsForContainers that forwards events before the FindContainer(userLabels) check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the log stream already subscribes to store events for newly started containers and re-checks with FindContainer at logs.go:427/481/528; a maintainer adding another event kind there could skip the check

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a per-host stats aggregation tool reading c.Stats for every container from ListAllContainers without a per-user filter
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: MCP tools already pass server-scope labels and have no per-request user plumbing

O9_family: Information exposure through missing authorization filter (CWE-200/CWE-285, per-user container visibility)

O10_build.toolchain: go 1.26.4 (go.mod:168); Makefile test target runs fake_assets + generate before go test
O10_build.project_tests: internal/web/events_test.go (Test_handler_streamEvents_happy, abide HTTP snapshots in internal/web/__snapshots__/web.snapshot) with MockedClient in internal/web/routes_test.go:67; internal/mcp/server_test.go

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Filter container-stat and container-event against the ID set from the initial ListAllContainers snapshot only, which drops events for in-scope containers started later and leaves MCP and notifications preview open.

out_of_scope_notes: Cloud tools/log streaming (internal/cloud) act at instance scope with an API key; not pursued.
update-host events and the hosts list are sent unfiltered (internal/web/events.go:58-62); host metadata, not container data.
unverified: present_in_latest for all O8 routes: no latest release provided.
Whether maintainers consider MCP and notifications preview admin-only; no role check was found in internal/web for them, but intent is not documented.
Cross-host container-ID collision in the host-less stat check (fix.diff:92-98) noted as a possible how-type differential; not examined further.
